_readme: The measured inputs of 48-platform-cost.md's ladder (lane/d-platform-cost, 2026-11-21). Aggregates only: no account, hero or session.
Seconds are PRODUCTION database-seconds. REAL = production read (tools/balance-program/platform-cost.local.mjs, 2026-11-21 07:00-08:00 UTC,
pg_stat_statements since 2026-10-31 13:42, 20.74 days, 40,015 s). MEASURED = this lane's replay runs (platform-cost.mjs profile/window/aged).
ESTIMATED = arithmetic on both, with the method in `why`. node tools/balance-program/platform-cost.mjs ladder prints the tables.

why.awayCommitsAnHour: REAL commits: 36.0 a hero-hour away at every party size, 14 days
why.watchedCommitsAnHour: REAL commits: 200.8 a four-hour watched (181 lone, 198 three)
why.watched.pollMs: REAL means: the settle read is closedCommitMs.four.read; hr_seed+perks 2.17; the hello six reads 21 ms x 1.6 a poll; hr_state_of 48 ms on 0.6 early asks a poll
why.watched.commitMs: the closed core plus: the asker's projection (REAL hr_state_of 48 ms) and 3 frames (60 ms: what is left of production's 203 ms apply mean)
why.watched.residualSAnHour: REAL minus the model: a watched four-hour is +107 to +119 s over an empty minute (capacity sample, 305 minutes); the model explains 110.2. UNATTRIBUTED
why.townHeroHourS: REAL: 46 town settles a town hero-hour (75,395 settles / 1,626 h) x (hr_tick_settle 2.45 calls x 18.6 ms + the visit's whole-character hr_state_of 0.84 x 48 ms + perks and seed 4 ms) = 90 ms a settle
why.townTabHourS: REAL x MEASURED (28): a tab standing in town alone, 660 calls an hour
why.pressS: REAL: hr_apply 59.6 ms + the state its answer carries 48 ms
why.fixedSADay: REAL (28): cron that runs whoever plays
why.closedCommitMs: REAL four: the settle read 183.4 ms (1,299 calls, min 164) and a closed apply of 95 ms (pg_stat_statements delta while one four hunted and no hero was open in a client: DELTA). Lone: the replay's lone/four ratios (read 35.9/103.5, apply 28.9/58.9 PGlite ms) x the four
why.offscreen: REAL hr_load 109-111 ms x 3 off-screen heroes x 60 an hour (28): gone with lane/c-server-cost (L01)

R0.why: REAL: the read before perks were folded in was 19.1 ms (38,631 calls); folded, with r inlined, 183.4. MEASURED on the replay: materialized, the four's read 103.5 -> 32.4 PGlite ms (x0.31), hr_hunt_instance_read 3 calls a settle -> 1. 35 ms central (19.1 + 4 perks of 1.83 = 26 to 183 x 0.31 = 57)

T1.why: REAL: the town visit reads the whole hero (hr_state_of 48 ms, 0.84 a settle) only to learn its activity and version: 40.7 of a town settle's 90 ms. MEASURED on the replay: 45% of the town settle

L12.why: RULED 28-1: a watched instance commits at the flush, as a closed one does

L24.why: 28's ASSUMED x4 on every whole-character read

L07.why: 59: 20 presses a day after Carry on and the plans

L13.why: MEASURED share: journal inserts and the day-budget reads, 5 to 10% of a commit on the replay (aged 0 to 4,500 rows today: +4 ms)

P1.why: ESTIMATED from the replay: after R0 the four's read still calls hr_hunt_member_read 24 times (4 members), hr_hunt_setup_live 176 times and hr_hunt_limit hundreds of times, and reads 15,710 hr_skill_curve rows; production's indexes read 3.03 billion skill-curve and 0.85 billion XP-table tuples in 20.7 days

TCF.why: 59: 3 statements a job, 2 jobs a hero a day, 20 ms each

C10.why: MEASURED: the same 20 minutes committed every 100 s and every 600 s end IDENTICAL on four fixtures; a 600 s commit costs 1.09 times a 100 s one (Krell four, read fixed: 53.4 -> 58.3 PGlite ms)
